fact: Biometric Update reports the government concluded an upgrade of the national population registry as the base for a national digital ID, with issuance announced but no confirmed start date.
source_slug: 2025-07-15 Zimbabwe looks forward to digital ID rollout after population registry reform

fact: The Civil Registry Department issues national identity documents, per the home affairs minister.
The Civil Registry Department issues national identity cards, per the Home Affairs minister.

Registrar-General Henry Machiri said the Civil Registry Department was issuing national ID cards from computerised offices, with machines each able to produce at least 200 cards a day, and that the ZPRS database holds each individual's national ID number.
